title: Zotero library task result
description: The final business payload returned by a Generic Zotero research-task Skill after the Runner transport marker has been removed.

status.description: completed when the declared bounded objective is verified; canceled when a material decision, identity, input, or authority is missing before safe completion; failed when an attempted objective cannot complete safely.

summary.description: A non-empty truthful account of what completed or stopped, including the material scope and limitations. Do not use a bare success label.

evidence.description: Inline source-oriented evidence supporting material claims or preserving stable recovery identity.

kind.description: Evidence family such as zotero-item, attachment, note, collection, workflow-run, operation-receipt, product, artifact, or source-locator.

ref.description: The stable reference returned by the owning Zotero or workflow contract. Preserve its machine shape.

locator.description: A page, section, annotation, quote span, cursor, asset role, or other precise locator when known.

description.description: Why this evidence supports the summary or matters for recovery.

artifacts.description: Files actually produced and available to the caller. Do not declare planned, missing, or Zotero-private paths.

role.description: The artifact's task role, such as candidate-report, analysis, synthesis-export, or residual-proposal.

mediaType.description: The artifact media type when known.

diagnostics.description: Structured limits, missing decisions, stable failure codes, and safe recovery information.

message.description: A concise human-readable explanation that does not expose credentials or private local paths.

examples.summary: Searched the complete bounded collection and found four current Zotero items matching the declared topic.

evidence.description: One of the four live items supporting the bounded answer.

examples.summary: Stopped before importing candidates because the target library and collection were not specified.

diagnostics.message: Choose the target library and collection before any acquisition write.

examples.summary: Analyzed one of three requested papers, but the overall comparison could not complete because the other two full texts were unavailable.

diagnostics.message: Two requested papers had metadata only; no full-text comparison was claimed.
